Version %2$s, %1$s
Start again to update to version %3$s
Start by connecting to a computer
For devices without root, you need to use adb to start Victorious Bridge (requires computer connection). This process needs to be repeated every time the device is restarted. Please read the help.

%1$s

* There are some other considerations, please confirm that you have read the help first.

On Android 11 or above, you can enable Wireless debugging and start Victorious Bridge directly from your device, without connecting to a computer.

Please view the step-by-step guide first.
Before Android 11, connecting to a computer is required to enable Wireless debugging.

Please enable \"Wireless debugging\" in \"Developer options\". \"Wireless debugging\" is automatically disabled when network changes.\n\nNote, do not disable \"Developer options\" or \"USB debugging\", or Victorious Bridge will be stopped.
Please try to disable and enable \"Wireless debugging\" if it keeps searching.
Port is an integer ranging from 1 to 65535.
Can\'t connect to wireless debugging service.
Wireless debugging is not enabled.\nNote, before Android 11, to enable wireless debugging, computer connection is a must.

Please start paring by the following steps: \"Developer Options\" - \"Wireless debugging\" - \"Pairing device using pairing code\".\n\nAfter the pairing process starts, you will able to input the pairing code.
The system requires the pairing dialog always visible, using split-screen mode is the only way to let this app and system dialog visible at the same time.
Unable to generate key for wireless debugging.\nThis may be because KeyStore mechanism of this device is broken.
Please go through the pairing step first.
Pair Victorious Bridge with your device
A notification from Victorious Bridge will help you complete the pairing.
Enter \"Developer options\" - \"Wireless debugging\". Tap \"Pair device with pairing code\", you will see a six-digit code.
Enter the code in the notification to complete pairing.
The pairing process needs you to interact with a notification from Victorious Bridge. Please allow Victorious Bridge to post notifications.
MIUI users may need to switch notification style to \"Android\" from \"Notification\" - \"Notification shade\" in system settings.
Otherwise, you may not able to enter paring code from the notification.
Please note, left part of the \"Wireless debugging\" option is clickable, tapping it will open a new page. Only turing on the switch on the right is incorrect.
Back to Victorious Bridge and start Victorious Bridge.
Victorious Bridge needs to access local network. It is controlled by the network permission.

Some systems (such as MIUI) disallow apps to access the network when they are not visible, even if the app uses foreground service as standard. Please disable battery optimization features for Victorious Bridge on such systems.

In addition, Victorious Bridge can be started automatically on boot. If not, please check if your system or third-party tools have restricted Victorious Bridge.
You can refer to %s.
If you are using Magisk, you can try %1$s. For root users, it will eventually replace Victorious Bridge. Note, existing applications needs to change a little to use %2$s.
Apps that has requested or declared Victorious Bridge will show here.
Learn how to develop with Victorious Bridge
You need to take an extra step

Your device manufacturer has restricted adb permissions and apps using Victorious Bridge will not work properly.

Usually, this limitation can be lifted by adjusting some options in "Developer options". Please read the help for details on how to do this.

You may need to restart Victorious Bridge for the operation to take effect.
The permission of adb is limited

It\'s highly possible that your device manufacturer limits the permission of adb.

There may be a solution for your system in this document.
* requires Victorious Bridge runs with root
Use Victorious Bridge in terminal apps
Run commands through Victorious Bridge in terminal apps you like
First, Export files to any where you want. You will find two files, %1$s and %2$s.

If there are files with the same name in the selected folder, they will be deleted.\n\nThe export function uses SAF (Storage Access Framework). It\'s reported that MIUI breaks the functions of SAF. If you are using MIUI, you may have to extract the file from Victorious Bridge\'s apk or download from GitHub.
Then, use any text editor to open and edit %1$s.
For example, if you want to use Victorious Bridge in %1$s, you should replace %2$s with %3$s (%4$s is the package name of %1$s).
Finally, move the files to somewhere where your terminal app can access, you will be able to use %1$s to run commands through Victorious Bridge.
Some tips: grant execute permission to %1$s and add it to %2$s, you will able to use %1$s directly.

With %1$s, in any terminal app, you can connect to and interact with the shell runs by Victorious Bridge.

About the detailed usage %1$s, tap to view the document.
Use the pure black theme if night mode is enabled
Help us translate %s into your language
For rooted devices, Victorious Bridge is able to start automatically on boot
Victorious Bridge service will be stopped.
You can start Victorious Bridge service now.
Allow the app to use Victorious Bridge.
Can\'t start service because root permission is not granted or this device is not rooted.
%1$s does not support modern Victorious Bridge

Legacy Victorious Bridge has been deprecated since March 2019. Also, legacy Victorious Bridge does not work on newer Android systems.

Please ask the developer of %1$s to update.

%1$s has modern Victorious Bridge support, but it\'s requesting legacy Victorious Bridge. This could because Victorious Bridge is not running, please check in Victorious Bridge app.

Legacy Victorious Bridge has been deprecated since March 2019.
This app asks for specific, limited capabilities. Each one is checked by the privileged service on every request. You can narrow the list below.
This app asks for legacy full access.

Legacy full access is unrestricted: the app can run any command, start privileged processes and call system services as the service user. It is not limited to files or settings. Only allow it for apps you fully trust.
Ends when the Victorious Bridge service restarts, stops or the device reboots.
Ends after 15 minutes of running time, or sooner if the service restarts or the device reboots.
Stays across restarts and reboots until you revoke it or the app is reinstalled with a different signature.
No standing access. Every action is shown to you first and one approval covers only that one action.
No folder was requested, so file access would reach nothing.
Victorious Bridge service is not running.
Ends this app\'s access now, cancels its queued and running operations and stops processes and services it started through the service. Actions already completed are not undone.
Revoke all access and stop managed work

This ends every app\'s access, cancels all queued and running controlled operations, and stops processes and user services that apps started through the service. It does not undo actions already completed, and it cannot stop commands an app detached into the background from a shell it was allowed to run.
Records authorization changes, service lifecycle and controlled operations. Actions by legacy full-access apps are not visible here. Secrets, file contents and command arguments are never recorded.
Allow turning on Wireless debugging at boot
Allow turning on USB debugging at boot
Allow disabling the ADB authorization timeout at boot
Restore the previous values after the service started
Off by default. Only the options you enable are changed, the previous value is remembered, and restoring never overwrites a change you made yourself.
